description_en: Retrieves the details of the security credit score of the current Alibaba Cloud account in a specific region
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号在指定地域的安全信誉分详情
name: DescribeDdosCredit

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html查询所有地域ID
parameters.name: ddos_region_id

DdosCredit.description_en: The details of the security credit score of the current Alibaba Cloud account in the specified region
DdosCredit.description_zh: 当前阿里云账号在指定地域的安全信誉分详情

BlackholeTime.description_en: The time period after which blackhole filtering is automatically deactivated in the specified region. Unit: minutes
BlackholeTime.description_zh: 阿里云账号在指定地域的黑洞自动解除时间。单位：分钟

Score.description_en: The security credit score. The full score is 1000

ScoreLevel.description_en:
The security credit level. Valid values:

A: outstanding

B: excellent

C: good

D: average

E: poor

F: poorer
ScoreLevel.description_zh:
安全信誉分等级。取值：

A：表示极好。
B：表示优秀。
C：表示良好。
D：表示中等。
E：表示较差。
F：表示极差

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: yes

false: no
Success.description_zh:
本次请求是否调用成功。取值：

true：表示调用成功。
false：表示调用失败
